info.name: Letta Archives API
info.description:
REST API for Letta, the stateful agents platform. Manage agents, memory blocks, archival passages, sources, custom tools, MCP servers, multi-agent groups, runs, and streaming responses. Available as Letta Cloud (managed) at https://api.letta.com/v1 and as the self-hosted open-source server (Apache-2.0) typically run at http://localhost:8283.

Contact Support:
 Name: Letta
 Email: support@letta.com

query.description: Agent ID cursor for pagination. Returns agents that come before this agent ID in the specified sort order
Agent ID cursor for pagination. Returns agents that come after this agent ID in the specified sort order
Maximum number of agents to return
Sort order for agents by creation time. 'asc' for oldest first, 'desc' for newest first

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the archive in the format 'archive-<uuid4>'

request.description: Get a list of agents that have access to an archive with pagination support.

response.name: Successful Response

header.description: Added as a part of security scheme: bearer
